summary: Clamps the stored offset at this+0xE0 (this[56]) into a valid scroll range and then tail-calls a virtual accessor. If the stored offset is negative it is reset to 0. Otherwise the offset plus the value returned by the virtual +0x18 accessor is compared against the value returned by the virtual +0x20 accessor; when it exceeds that extent the offset is rewritten as extent minus position, so offset + position stays within the extent. In all cases the result of the virtual +0xA8 call is returned. The +0x18, +0x20 and +0xA8 accessors are dispatched through the vtable pointer at this+0x0.

local_names.position: value returned by virtual vtable slot +0x18
local_names.extent: value returned by virtual vtable slot +0x20
local_names.state: value returned by virtual vtable slot +0xA8

operations.description: Sign check on the stored offset: if this[0xE0] >= 0 take the clamping path, otherwise reset this[0xE0] to 0.
Compute v2 = this[0xE0] + position where position is the result of the virtual call at vtable slot +0x18 (vtable pointer at this+0x0).
Overflow check: if v2 > extent, where extent is the result of the virtual call at vtable slot +0x20, enter the clamp branch.
Clamp branch: this[0xE0] = extent - position, so the offset keeps offset + position within the extent.
Else branch: when the stored offset is negative, this[0xE0] = 0.
Tail virtual dispatch: call the accessor at vtable slot +0xA8 (vtable pointer at this+0x0) and use its result as the return value.
Return the result of the virtual +0xA8 call.
